name: Dead bug
description: Lie on your back and lower your opposite arm and leg slowly while your lower back stays down.

name: Bird dog
description: On hands and knees, extend your opposite arm and leg while keeping your hips level.

name: Pelvic tilt
description: Lie with your knees bent and gently tilt your pelvis to flatten your lower back.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes, breathing steadily.

name: Side plank
description: Balance on one forearm with your body in a straight line, then hold.

name: Pallof press
description: Stand sideways to a cable, press the handle out, and resist the pull that tries to rotate you.

name: Hanging knee raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise your knees toward your chest with control.

name: Russian twist
description: Sit with your knees bent, lean back slightly, and rotate your torso from side to side.

name: Ab wheel rollout
description: Kneel and roll the wheel forward as far as you can control, then pull back.
caution: Stop before the lower back arches. Keep the hips in line with the shoulders.

name: Hanging leg raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise straight legs forward, keeping the movement slow.
caution: Control the lowering. Stop if you feel low back strain or grip pain.

name: Seated knee tuck
description: Sit near the front of a chair, hold the sides, and draw your knees gently toward your chest.

name: Supine heel slide
description: Lie on your back and slide one heel out and back, keeping your lower back gently pressed down.
